nom: Philosophy Purity One-Step Meltaway Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: I was eager to try this because I love the regular purity cleanser. This might do an okay job cleansing your face, but a "balm" it is not. It is like rubbing cold cream onto your face. It is bot smooth and easy to spread around like a typical cleansing balm. It is thick and takes effort to move aroubd the face. Its fine when you add water and it rinses clean (with a TON of water) and it is boy irritating to the eyes. But if you are expecting an actual balm cleanser, stay away!
I have used the Purity Cleanser for many years, because it gets the job done when it comes to removing makeup including mascara.

Really impressed with Philosophy Purity One-Step Meltaway Cleansing Balm. It melts into the skin and effortlessly breaks down makeup, sunscreen, and daily grime without any harsh rubbing. My skin feels clean, soft, and not stripped afterward, which is a big win. The texture is silky and rinses off easily without leaving a greasy film. Only reason it's 4 stars is the scent is a bit noticeable and the jar packaging isn't the most travel-friendly. Still, a solid, gentle cleanser that does exactly what it promises.

I recently tried the Philosophy Purity One Step Cleansing Balm, and honestly, it was… just okay. The texture felt nice at first, but once I started working it into my skin, it tugged a bit more than I expected from a balm. I kept trying to warm it up between my hands, but the drag never really went away. It also didn't fully remove my waterproof mascara. Even after taking the time to massage it in, I still had smudges under my eyes and needed to follow up with another cleanser. For something marketed as a one‑step product, I was hoping for a more thorough cleanse. It did remove my foundation and base makeup well. I've tried the cleanser version of this balm and loved this! Overall, it wasn't terrible, but it didn't wow me either.

This is a rich creamy cleansing balm immediately absorbs oils, dirt and impurities of my skin leaving my dry skin incredibly hydrated and smooth without leaving a greasy feeling. The formula is very gentle and effective and lightweight and you just need a little bit it really goes a long way. It's my new favorite cleanser for my everyday skincare routine. I would highly recommend it.

avis.titre: Melts away makeup effortlessly, leaves skin soft a
avis.texte: This Balm is an absolute skincare gem. It effortlessly melts away makeup, sunscreen, and daily impurities without stripping the skin of its natural moisture. The texture is silky and luxurious, turning into a soft oil as you massage it in, leaving the skin feeling clean, nourished, and comfortable. It's gentle enough for all skin types, including sensitive skin, and the subtle, calming scent adds a spa-like experience to your cleansing routine.

Love the scent and love the thick texture. It removes my foundation well, but when it comes to mascara and eyeliner, it lacks compared to my Korean cleansing balm. Needs a lot more product just to partially remove my mascara
This melting balm is great for my skin it feels great and leaves my skin clean without any residue. Leaving a pure, soft finish. Influenster allowed me to try this in exchange for my honest opinion.

This cleansing balm is so thick and luxurious on the skin. It has the lightest scent, I can message it on my eyelids and it doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes while removing all my eye primer/shadow/liner and mascara. Moisturizing and not striping at all. While the packaging is a little lack luster, it doesn't irritate feel super secure and durable.

This cleansing balm is amazing. It melts makeup instantly, even waterproof mascara, without any harsh rubbing. My skin feels clean, soft, and hydrated after rinsing—no greasy residue at all. Perfect for an easy and gentle end-of-day cleanse.

This stuff is amazing Helps melt away your makeup without harsh rubbing. Just a small amount goes a long way. Does not have an odor. Can be used for someone with sensitive skin, I have bad redness on my cheeks and did not think it caused increased redness. Would definitely recommend

This makeup cleansing balm is so thick and creamy and doesnt take much. I add a splash of water to it and really rub in small circles all over my face for a couple of minutes and it does a fantastic job of breaking down makeup and rinsing clean. My fave is left feeling silky and moisturized instead of tight and dry so its perfect for winter especially when im dealing with more dryness. It feels luxurious and has a gentle space like scent.

Creamy and luxe, takes off the day and rinses clean. No film left behind on the eyes. No irritation to the eyes. The packaging is durable and safe to take on travel. It's a nice way to take makeup off as the first cleanse.
I generally like all philosophy products but had not tried this one. It works very well and didn't cause any breakouts at the onset which sometimes happens
This cleansing balm has a light, clean smell and is thick and creamy. A little goes a long way. It removed my mascara and makeup with ease and it didn't irritate my sensitive skin.

I love this Philosophy Purity Cleansing Balm It melts my makeup and sunscreen fast without harsh rubbing. It rinses clean with no greasy residue, leaving my skin soft and comfortable. Overall, it performs well and makes cleansing quick and gentle.

avis.titre: Melt away your makeup on just one step
avis.texte: I found this product refreshing and it smells beautiful; my face feels super clean after one use. It melts away all my makeup, leaving my face feeling revitalized.
This works soooo well! It easily removes my makeup and makes washing your face so easy. I highly recommend buying and using this product. It made it so simple to remove my makeup.

I love this balm. The texture is nice. It feels wonderful as you put it on your face. The scent is wonderful, light, and clean. It rinses off nicely and cleans those pores. It took all the lip products off and most of the waterproof eye makeup. I did use micellar water to get the rest of the waterproof eye makeup off. What I love is how my skin felt after I used it. My skin was soft and smooth. I love this product.

I feel like I had to rub a little extra to get this to dissolve the makeup, but when I dried my face, it was smooth and clean. It's a thicker texture but feels amazing on the face. It has a light, fresh smell typical for Philosophy products. Overall, I'm very satisfied with it and will enjoying it up.

avis.titre: Works great and makes the face so soft!
avis.texte: I was very pleasantly surprised by this cleanser. It has a nice light fragrance, not overpowering. You apply it to damp skin, and it really rubs in and melts in your skin, and makes the skin feel clean but soft afterwards. A little goes a LONG way, I used way too much at first. On damp skin it really disperses the product well so you only need a dot. The ingredients are fairly clean too which is always a win!

It's a nice texture on the skin, and it does melt makeup nicely but I feel like it leaves a film on my skin after rinsing and it has a very strong scent. For me, those two things are dealbreakers. I think if you like scented products, you might like this. And also if you like a good double cleanse, then this could work for you!

Thick and creamy texture. No smell and seems to remove any left over makeup that the first step didn't take off. It'll last a while as I only need a little per wash- maybe some size amount. Haven't noticed a difference in skin appearance yet but it feels clean after use!

Using a cleansing balm in the shower has been a game changer for me this past year and I think this philosophy one may be my new favorite. It's on the thicker side and I feel as if it lathers up well so I'm not having to use a ton. Between this and a face wash all makeup residue is gone!
A gentle cleansing balm that melts away makeup and impurities, leaving skin soft and clean. Great for daily use, but may need a second cleanse for heavy or waterproof makeup.

She's thick, silky, non-greasy with only a slight fragrance. I'm impressed with the overall results. I'm typically not a fan of cleansing gels, balms or creams because they have tendency to make me break out, but this one rinses off nicely. I've been using it nightly for a couple of weeks and so far, so good.

avis.titre: 10/10! One of the BEST products I've tried!
avis.texte: This product is absolutely amazing. I've always actually LOVE MELT OFF cleansing balm!! I like to use them to wash my face and cleanse off my makeup after a long day. I love them because they're so gentle on the skin especially this one, I love the texture of it and it's so easy to use and I have sensitive skin, so I always worry about around my eyes and causing breakouts after usage, but this one did not do that. It left my skin not only so clean but super soft as well. I loved how beautiful and great quality the packaging was as well because it makes it better to be able to open easily and store easily without it getting 'rotted' in a way and I really like this product. I'll definitely be repurchasing. This is a 10 out of 10 for me and I recommended it to anyone that wants an easier way to cleanse your face and remove your makeup.

avis.titre: I had so much potential for this product
avis.texte: When reviewing this product I had so much expectation for this to melt away my makeup but I was wrong. It is very very rare for me to not like a complimentary product. Sadly there was no melting of the product. I had to grab a baby wipe with water and wipe away my makeup. For a second I thought it was lotion I had to read and make sure it was a makeup remover. Maybe I'm wrong but this product was not for me.

It's a great thick foaming wash. However after using it my face instantly started breaking out and left it itchy. It did provide a nice moisturizer to my skin. Packaging was simple which is nice. The scent is soft and didn't linger.

I've been using this as my first cleanse for a while now and I've been happy with the results. In terms of effectiveness, this does exactly what it claims to do.. it totally melts and removes all makeup. A little goes a long way so this tub will last a while. I prefer to use a spatula rather than my hands so I do wish this came with one. The texture is nice, it's a little more nourishing than a simple solid oil. I'm on the fence about the scent. It doesn't bother me but it doesn't draw me in either.

avis.titre: Will most definitely be buying this product again.
avis.texte: I love how this product doesnt irritate the skin. The texture feels just like lotion. Overall I love how this product removes makeup without any harsh scrubbing. Doesn't irritate my sensitive skin at all. Overall, I love the value of the product.

I am a huge fan of Philosphy , so I was excited to try the one step meltaway cleansing balm . First impression, loved the sunny yellow jar , the texture was silky to the touch . I scooped a finger full and applied to my face dry ( you can add water to face first before applying also ) I chose to use on dry skin ,because I wanted to remove my stubborn mascara first then massage some more into other areas . I quickly learned a little goes a long way , if you add water to it . I think I used too much my first trial , because it took a couple rinses to remove . I adjusted the amount next try and it was effortless to rinse . After rinse , my combo skin felt silky , buttery soft , I was astounded by the softness not only of my skin , but my lashes were so clean , soft and no trace of residual mascara . This totally lives up to its name as an amazing cleansing balm "made simple "

Philosophy cleansing balm works wonders! The balm has a butter like consistency and truly melts on my face. This is very hydrating and leaves my skin so soft! I absolutely love this cleansing balm and highly recommend this to anyone who needs a little luxury.

avis.titre: Melt away my makeup! Love it!
avis.texte: Philosophy purity one-step melt away cleansing balm is perfect, I just used a small amount and it removed my makeup completely in one step, my face feels fresh and cleaned, nice appearance, texture and scent. Love it!

avis.titre: Love how its super easy to get kakeup off
avis.texte: I've been loving Philosophy Purity One‑Step Meltaway Cleansing Balm — it's so satisfying as the first step in my skincare routine! This creamy balm melts into an oil and effortlessly dissolves makeup (even long-wear and waterproof), SPF, and daily buildup without tugging or stripping my skin. 🫧 It rinses clean with a gentle milky finish and leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and hydrated — perfect for prepping your face before your regular cleanser. 💦 #SkincareWin #CleanBeauty

avis.titre: Great sunscreen film remover that leaves skin fres
avis.texte: This cleansing balm makes it so simple and effortless to remove the stay on skin products like sunscreens and makeup. Just apply and let the cleansing balm do its magic to melt away the film that gets left behind on our skin. It is an easy to apply thick creamy texture that has no strong fragrance. Makes my skin feel clean and clear of the leftover film some products can leave.

This Philosophy Cleansing Balm has become a staple in my makeup removal routine at night time. This balm really breaks down all my makeup leaving my skin and face feeling completely refreshed after washing. It doesn't leave my skin feeling dry or dull. I cannot recommend this product enough!

I tested this balm for free in exchange for my honest review of this product. Overall it's wonderful! It feels really soft and not greasy going on and is super gentle while removing makeup. My skin felt super soft afterwards. My only complaints were my eyes felt a little irritated afterwards and it did not remove a few bits of mascara. Otherwise, it is one of the best cleansers out there. 1,000 times better than micellar water or half of the oils available on the market!
I liked this product. İt has a nice, silky texture. I like how it lathers on my skin. No scent which I really appreciate. Packaging could be better though.

I tried this cleaning balm on both light and heavy makeup. It works great in both scenarios! It even removed my mascara with some effort. The only thing I will say, is that in my dry colorado winter climate and dry face, I needed to add water to it, which may be the trick, because it becomes sudsy like soap! It comes off easily with warm water. The smell is amazing, very fresh. The packaging is cute as well and won't break. I noticed no irritations or reactions while using this product. It seems very gentle. I do need to quickly add a moisturizer but I'm not sure if it's the cleaning nature of this product, the dry winter air, or both. I prefer a more hydrating remover for this reason, but I like this product overall and would recommend, just have a moisturizer ready if you live in a dry climate!

I used this before my shower on mascara and it took it off wonderfully. I usually wash my face in the shower and then use a makeup wipe to remove the remaining residue, but there was no residue using this before. It went on smooth and I opened my eyes with it on without irritation. I like this brand and am excited to use it again on a fuller face of makeup.

I was very impressed with this cleansing balm. I was skeptical that it would remove my 2 coats of mascara and lash primer as well as full face of makeup. It removed all of my makeup and mascara and left no black under my eyes. It is a very creamy texture, but it blends well. It was breathable on my skin and didn't leave a film or leave my skin feeling clogged or oily. I would highly recommend.

I love how easy this is to use! It smells amazing, a little goes a long way, I got a little too happy and put a bit much. But it made my skin feel fresh and clean. It didn't leave any residue behind! It's also clearing my skin and smells amazing! I will for sure be purchasing this after I use this philosophy free sample! Run don't walk! Add this into your skin care routine!

The philosophy cleansing balm does exactly what it says. Upon the first wash, it took off 90% of my makeup. After the second wash all my makeup was removed from my face. I usually apply my balms dry and then wet and lather my face. It did not leave my skin feeling stripped, but it did have a fresh clean feeling.
I love the way this cleansing balm melts away my makeup with a quick scrub. It's soft on my skin but is effective at removing make up effortlessly. It smells amazing and does not make me break out!

avis.titre: A must for your face cleaning routine
avis.texte: Melt the day away with this gentle and powerful cleansing balm. Philosophy's One Step Meltaway Balm transforms from a rich balm into a skillet oil then rinses clean , effortlessly dissolving makeup, sunscreen and impurities. Skin is left soft, hydrated and comforted. Perfect for all skin types, including sensitive skin

avis.titre: A little goes a long way!
avis.texte: I received this product from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. At first I wasn't sure I liked it, it was so thick. I wasn't used to such a thick texture for my cleansing balms so it took a few days to figure out the perfect amount. Now that I have that figured out, I love this balm. It does have a scent, but nothing overwhelming, and perfume is very low on the list of ingredients. A little goes a long way into cleansing and removing makeup. Does a pretty good job removing waterproof makeup as well. My skin feels clean, and hydrated after use. Many other brands leave my skin feeling clean, but stripped. I feel confident my skin is clean after using this balm, I have had fewer breakouts and fewer dry patches. This is a wonderful product and it will be replacing my previous cleansing balm brands. The container is a basic plastic case, and has a plastic seal insert, and screws down tightly. Would travel well. I recommend this cleansing balm to anyone looking for a good for your skin, hydrating cleanser.
This is a Fantastic cleansing balm. It's a little bit of a whipped texture, Melts into skin, and removes eye makeup effortlessly. A little goes a long way. Great for Sensitive skin.

The Philosophy | Purity One-Step Meltaway Cleansing Balm is everything I want in a cleanser. It melts effortlessly into the skin, dissolves makeup even stubborn mascara and sunscreen, without any harsh rubbing, and rinses clean with zero greasy residue. My skin feels incredibly soft, clean, and balanced afterward never tight or stripped. The texture is luxurious, the scent is light and comforting, and it's gentle enough for everyday use. This has completely simplified my nighttime routine and left my skin looking healthier and more radiant. Repurchasing forever!!

I loved how how hydrated my face felt after using this. It is a bit thicker than a typical makeup cleansing balm which I think aids in it being so hydrating. There's a very light scent and my makeup came off super easily!

Thank you Philosophy and Influenster for my complementary gift

This balm was very thick, smelled super nicely, and cleansed my face and mascara really well. I used a dime sized amount, warmed it between my hands, and then cleansed my face. I did add a tiny bit of water bc it is very thick! It worked great and left my face clean but moisturized. It didn't strip!

This product worked really well and lathered my face (almost felt like an actual face wash). Did melt of my makeup after cleansing but I did feel like it needed an extra step of cleansing. No residue or icky feel afterwards which is great.

avis.titre: The formula is think and it has essence

This has made my life simpler. Im recovering from major surgery and some days it's hard to get in my entire cleansing routine. This makes it easy. It leaves my skin feeling clean. Easy to apply. No residue. And it leaves my skin feeling soft which is huge because a lot of the meds im currently on have left my skin really dry.

This product is high end! All of your senses will pick up on the high quality and luxury of this cleansing balm. It is very effective and the results speak for themselves! Applying this product is easily comparable to a spa like treatment. After just a few uses, my skin is already noticeably softer, more radiant, and feels renewed. I would recommend this cleansing balm to all because this is definitely a product that you are going to want to have!

This cleansing balm feels so creamy on the skin! I didn't have to use anywhere near as much as I did in the photo because a little bit would go a long way. After I rinsed it off my skin felt so smooth, soft, and clean. I honestly can't remember the last time my skin felt this good!

This product works wonders! It melts away all my makeup and residue from the day and leave me feeling new, I don't need to use to much of it so that nice aswell. It does leave my skin a tad bit oily afterwords but other than that I like it

Philosophy purity one step mettaway cleansing balm is everything I love from Philosophy and more. It's easy to apply evenly on my face, ensuring that I am cleansing my entire face. Washing off the cleanser is just as easy and like the name says it meltsaway. It has a very light minimal fresh clean and refreshing scent. It's easy to track with as the conditioner is easy to close and prevent from opening. I enjoy ending my day cleansing with this balm, waking up feeling moisturized and refreshed.

I do like the way this took my make up off. Now the negatives for me are the smell. I really do not like the way this smells. It is a little oily feeling and left that cast feeling on my face. It was fine after using a cleanser after it. The texture is okay it goes on well and a little does go a long way.

This might be the worst cleansing balm I've ever tried. It was like rubbing lotion onto my face. It didn't melt down any makeup in my face. It caused breakouts after using it one time (the only thing that changed in my routine) . Its one redeeming quality might be that it didn't have a weird scent.
Works! I used this for the first time and you need a tiny pea size for your entire face! I wear light makeup so a pea size definitely took my whole makeup off!

Philosophy is a brand I trust and have used in the past. I am a fan of cleansing balms and was excited to try this one. The formula is a good creamy texture with a light scent scent. Dissolves makeup pretty easily and washes away without a residue. Leaves skin feel fresh and clean

Cleansing balm that is great at taking off face makeup such as foundation, concealer, ect. Eye makeup is harder to take off and I usually take it off with micellar water. Perfect for a first step cleanser but I would follow up with another. The scent is pleasant. I haven't noticed any irritation or reaction to this product. It would be easy to travel with if put in a smaller container which would be simple to scoop it.
This took off tough makeup easily. Feels very nice on the face. Its easy to get out of the tub just grab and go for quick showers. Love the lack of scent in it. . Nice colors of the tub.

I received this product as a complementary in exchange of my honest review. At first I was skeptical but once I applied the product I realized that was good. Melts easily the make up. I don't use heavy make up and for me was easier to take off the product. My skin look and feel hydrated. I used three dots and was enough for my face so this product will be for a long time used. This is a must have.

Amazing product for removing makeup and sweat! Love the fresh clean scent, consistency and ingredients list. The packaging is super cute, too. It definitely melts all of your buildup away from the day, leaving skin feeling fresh and hydrated! It also helped me with a recent break out. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Obsessed! This will be in my night routine from no

The light citrus scent is so fresh and relaxing. Taking my makeup off finally feels like a treat instead of a chore

I am surprised at how well this cleansing balm removed the makeup off of my face. I was expecting a different texture at first when applying it. But I love how it felt when I rinsed it off with water it left my skin feeling so much cleaner and refreshed. It left no residue behind and I experienced no breakouts.

I've been loving this cleansing balm. It melts into the skin, removes makeup and sunscreen effortlessly, and leaves my face feeling clean but not stripped. My skin feels soft, hydrated, and calm after every use. Definitely a staple in my routine.
This is hands-down, my new favorite formula. I love that you can use it waterless. It is so easy and takes everything off without causing irritation to the eye area.

I've already tried some Philosophy skincare before and I like how gentle is with the skin. This balm is creamier than regular cleansing balms that have a thick texture and sometimes is hard to apply them. This one melt into my skin easily removing all my makeup, even waterproof one. I did emulsify it for a better cleanse and I liked that it didn't irritate my eyes. It does have like a citrus scent, it isn't too strong but maybe if you don't like scented products this would be an issue for you. It left my skin feeling and looking very clean, and it didn't dry it, my skin felt smooth and hydrated afterwards

The cleansing balm is amazing it cleans my face very well and makeup goes with on one wash and the residue is gonna wash away by using face wash later that..It glides smoothly the texture is great and th scent is subtle too.Tge product is on point for the value I paid..

This product is very thick and feels like coconut oil. I rubbed it on my face and could only rinse it off if I used hot water to melt it off. It didn't fully take my mascara off and I used a lot of product

I love how easy this makes taking makeup off! Usually I just use face wash to get my makeup off, but this works so much better as a first step! It's a great texture and does great getting all my mascara to melt off!

Purity One-Step Meltaway Cleansing Balm, and honestly… it's become a non-negotiable in my routine. This balm melts into the skin and effortlessly dissolves makeup, SPF, dirt, and all the stress from the day—without stripping or leaving that tight feeling behind. I love how it transforms from a solid balm into a silky oil, then rinses clean while leaving my skin soft, calm, and refreshed 🤍 No harsh rubbing. No complicated steps. Just clean, comfortable skin that feels ready for the rest of my routine (or bed). If you're into simple, effective skincare that feels a little luxurious, this one's worth trying. Because cleansing should feel like self-care, not a task

avis.titre: A gentle but powerful cleansing balm that melts ma
avis.texte: I've been using the philosophy purity one-step meltaway cleansing balm and it's quickly become one of my favorite makeup removers. The texture feels buttery and comforting in the hands, and once you massage it into the skin it literally melts all makeup away — even stubborn foundation, waterproof mascara, and long-wear lipstick. I love that it includes hydrating glycerin, because my skin never feels tight or dry after rinsing; instead it feels soft, balanced, and clean. The balm glides smoothly without pulling or tugging, which makes it feel gentle even around the eyes. It rinses off easily with warm water or a damp cloth, leaving no greasy film behind. The scent is light and fresh — noticeable but not overwhelming — which I appreciate first thing in the morning or after a long day. Overall this cleansing balm feels like a little daily treat: effective, soothing, and kind to the skin.

Super thick and buttery! It feels great on the skin but it is a little stubborn to remove because of how heavy it is. It takes a bit but my makeup is also fully removed after using this! Perfect for the days when you're wearing a full face of makeup.

This cleanser is a much creamer balm than others I've used. It creates a nice lather and actually feels hydrating. Easily removes all of my makeup. I don't love the perfume scent but it doesn't linger in the skin after rinsing so it's bare able.

The first thing that caught my eye was the beautiful packaging, but the formula is what truly won me over. The consistency is perfect, it feels so luxurious on the skin and dissolves makeup effortlessly, even the stubborn waterproof products. What I love most is that it is incredibly gentle and doesn't irritate my skin or eyes at all. It leaves my face feeling clean, soft, and nourished rather than stripped or greasy. It truly makes my double-cleansing routine a dream. If you're looking for a high-quality balm that feels amazing and works even better, this is a 10/10!

I loved it! 😊 Philosophy Purity Made Simple is a gentle yet effective facial cleanser that leaves my skin clean and refreshed. Its simple but powerful formula removes dirt and makeup without drying out my skin. I appreciate that it's hypoallergenic and suitable for sensitive skin. It's a staple in my skincare routine!

Philosophy is one of those brands that you know you can trust and this balm lives up to the name. I'm a big cleaning balm girl and this exceeded my expectations. It is gentle on your skin, doesn't cause breakouts and leaves you feeling clean and refreshed! Highly recommended!
This balm was great ! I put on some foundation for you to see the comparison when I took it off and it worked great ! My skin feels soft where I used it and it left no residue ! I would recommend !

I felt so lucky when I got this. I wear quite a bit of makeup for work and my favorite way to remove it is using a melting balm. I've used plenty but this one has become one of my favorites. The smell is sweet like perfume but not overpowering. It takes everything off without irritating my eyes which is a plus. There's no left over after rinsing. I recommend

I've really enjoyed using this cleansing balm because it actually makes taking off makeup feel effortless — the rich balm texture melts into an oil on your skin, breaking down long-wear and even waterproof makeup without tugging or irritating, then rinses clean into a light, milky finish that doesn't leave any greasy film behind; my face feels genuinely clean but still soft and hydrated afterward, which is such a nice change from harsher makeup removers that strip my skin, and while it's a bit of an indulgence compared to basic cleansers, I've found it's calming on my skin and a pleasant way to end the day.

avis.titre: Thick Lather that melts all makeup away.
avis.texte: The Philosophy Purity Cleansing Balm is hands down one of the best makeup removers I've ever used. The texture is buttery and creamy, and when you apply it to a damp face, it turns into a rich, thick lather that effortlessly melts away all makeup. The scent is very light and fresh, and it leaves your skin feeling incredibly soft, clean, and refreshed.

avis.titre: Gentle, and effective to melt away make up ❤️
avis.texte: I've been using this cleansing balm for a few weeks now, and it's quickly become a staple in my routine. The texture is smooth and buttery, melts instantly into the skin, and breaks down makeup (even waterproof mascara) without any harsh rubbing. It emulsifies beautifully when water is added and rinses off clean, leaving my skin soft and hydrated—never greasy or tight. I also really appreciate that it doesn't sting my eyes and has a subtle, non-overpowering scent. After cleansing, my skin feels clean but comfortable, which makes it a great first step in a double-cleanse or even on its own for lighter makeup days. Definitely a solid option if you're looking for an effective yet gentle cleansing balm.
Nice consistency. Melts makeup away really easy. I like that there is also no strong smell. This will be used nightly by me! Over all good product .

Philosophy purity made simple. One- step meltaway cleansing balm is truly one of a kind. My skin feels so hydrated after applying. Super gentle formula. Easy on the skin. I've had no irritation. Suitable for all skin types and textures. Gently removing dirt and makeup for a flawless complexion. The scent of the meltaway balm is very subtle. I feel like Philosophy transformed the skincare game when they came out with this product. It's a must have to anyone's skincare routine.

Thank you @influenster for letting me try this product! My skin feels clean, soft, and calm after using it - which I really appreciate, especially on tired skin. I tried it, I finished it and went to buy it because I loved it . It's gentle, simple, and perfect for everyday use, even on days when I'm exhausted and just want something easy and effective. Great option if you want a no-drama cleanser that actually does its job.100/10

I didn't know what to expect If it was the same as other cleaners, but I used it to clean and wash my face. It left iit smooth and it really did leave. my face, feeling clean and smooth afterwards, and it washed off really well. They didn't leave any residue behind my skin. Did feel soft after i've used it
This was a thicker consistency than expected but it worked well at removing makeup and leaving my face nice and soft! Didn't irritate my eyes or skin at all. Will def use all of it.
The Philosophy Purity One-Step Meltaway Cleansing Balm dissolves everything effortlessly while leaving my skin soft, clean, and never stripped! A must for my nightly routine 🌙

This new purity one-step meltaway balm is very new & different. I have used this to take off eyebrow makeup face makeup eye makeup, and more! This cleansing balm is very effective glides on smoothly and is so easy to use. This is a must have in my routine now. It's absolutely amazing guys.

This cleansing balm is firm but goes on with easy. I help melt away the makeup I wore all day, even my waterproof mascara. The formula is hydrating and nourishing, leaving the skin feeling soft, hydrated, and comfortable without a greasy residue. The aroma is soft, not over potent, or chemically.
Sadly this product did not work for me fully. It removed and cleaned my face good but left a rather oily residue on my skin and broke me out during the first time using

avis.titre: New staple in my nigh time routine
avis.texte: This is the first time I've ever used a cleansing balm and I absolutely love this product. I'll be adding it to my night time routine from now on. It helps to remove makeup and build up from throughout the day then I use my normal cleanser afterwards. It makes my face feel so clean after using both!

tried this cleansing balm and it does remove makeup really well, even heavier makeup. However, I found it a bit difficult to use compared to other cleansing balms on the market. The texture feels different — it doesn't melt as easily and requires more effort to work into the skin. I liked the results overall and my skin felt clean afterward, but the texture wasn't my favorite. I enjoyed using it, but I'm not completely sure I would repurchase it. It's good, just not a must-have for me.

Philosophy Purity Made Simple is one of my favorites. I love the light, fresh scent and soft texture. It's gentle on my skin but removes makeup effortlessly, leaving no residue and leaving my skin feeling fresh and clean.

I really enjoy this Philosophy Purity Made Simple Meltaway Cleansing Balm because it melts makeup and sunscreen easily without irritating my skin. The texture feels rich but rinses off clean, leaving my face soft and not greasy. It's gentle, effective, and great for a simple first cleanse, especially for sensitive skin. Worth it.

avis.titre: Great product from a trusted brand!
avis.texte: This cleansing balm melts into my skin and washes all my make up away. I love that it doesn't leave a greasy residue either. It leaves leaves my face feeling soft and hydrated. I love this brand, great product!

The Philosophy purity one step melt away cleansing balm makes makeup removal effortless. It cleans and removes makeup and dirt quickly. I like with other cleanser balms, my skins feels hydrated after using this.

This product works so good!!! Rub on dry face and rinse off! The is worth the buy! It removed all my water proof make up in seconds! Doesn't take long to wipe away! The consistency is smooth! It has a clean smell.

This was recommended to me by one of the employees because I've been battling dry skin. This removes makeup so easily including mascara and your face will feel incredibly soft and hydrated afterwards. It does not have that typical cleansing balm feel of feeling greasy. Its like a rich cream. It easily has become a new fave.
Oh my!! This is an absolute game changer for washing your day away. Leaves my skin so soft amd moisturized after washing away my makeup. Game changer for my dry winter skin!

I have combination skin and this didn't make me feel greasy afterwards or super dry it removed my waterproof mascara and definitely left my skin feeling clean and smooth it has no scent and even if it did I wouldn't mind it absorbed enough to remove the makeup not enough to make me feel heavy or as if I had put something too oily
This has been a great addition to my pm routine! I love the texture- it is so creamy and soft! It removes every bit of my makeup without leaving a film or making my eyes blurry!

This balm does a great job in getting off mascara, eyeliner and other makeup. Melts it away. It's a little more greasier than other balms I've used and find that you do need to follow up with a good cleanser to get the oils off. You won't get rid of your makeup until you do. Have a scent to it. It seems herbal and isn't overpowering. Feels good on the skin. I deducted 1 star due to it being more oily on the skin than balmy.

I received this Philosophy Cleansing Balm to try for my honest review. Does cleanser?It is very effective yet gentle. It definitely helps remove the makeup easier. I love the creamy formula in that it is not sticky. I would purchase this. Thank you for the complimentary sample.

Thick and luxurious this cleansing balm not only cleans your skin effectively it leaves it very soft and smooth. You don't need to use a lot to even remove waterproof makeup and mascara. There is not a very strong fragrance and you don't need to use any other soaps after removing your makeup to cleanse the skin. I highly recommend this balm and will definitely be buying more!

I recently tried the philosophy purity made simple cleansing balm. I'm impressed with how effectively it removes my makeup and cleanses my skin. The texture is luxurious, it melts from a solid balm into a silk oil when warmed between your fingers. It feels really nice on my skin. Stubborn makeup including waterproof mascara and long wear foundation came off smoothly without harsh scrubbing. I love how gentle it is, my skin felt clean and refreshed without tightness or dryness. It doesn't leave behind a greasy residue. The scent is light and pleasant.
This product is phenomenal. The formulation ingredients and ladder are exceptional. The application is easy in the packaging is simple. Definitely would recommend.

I've been sleeping on philosophy! I forgot how much I love their products. This cleansing balm has a thick formula that dissolves my makeup seamlessly - even getting eye makeup and mascara out without an issue. I personally double cleanse and go in after with a cleanser to get super clean. But this cleansing balm could be used on its own to get everything out.

I've been using this cleansing balm for a little while now and I'm honestly so impressed. The texture is rich and smooth, and it melts beautifully into the skin, removing makeup and impurities without leaving any greasy residue. My skin feels clean, soft, and hydrated after every use. It's also very gentle and doesn't irritate my skin or eyes, which is a huge plus for me. A little goes a long way, so the jar will definitely last. Thank you so much I'm really happy with this product and truly appreciate it!

I love me a good cleansing balm & this is really good , it literally takes off everything , great texture , feels good And also removes makeup easily skin feels great afterwards , no scent that i know of & the packaging is perfect

This cleansing balm is awesome..it doesn't feel like it has any artificial chemicals. It really feels so natural and smooth on the skin. I love how there's no residue and it leaves my eyes and lips not burning.

Upon application this balm melted off the makeup. I don't wear full glam makeup but do wear foundation and daytime makeup which was handled well by this product. It smelled nice and felt soft and silky when using,resulting in a very nice feel on the face and hands. Taking off my makeup became an experience rather than a chore, part of my self-care regimen rather than simply a requirement for less finicky skin. Highly recommend.

This cleansing balm is great! It has a very light scent that I would compare to essential oils and lemongrass. It also feels very gentle on your skin and does a great job at melting away all of my makeup in the shower! Lastly, it hasn't irritated my sensitive skin at all and hasn't caused any breakouts since I've started using it! I would highly recommend this cleansing balm :)

avis.titre: Great function, don't like that it's scented
avis.texte: Creamy and thick texture. I apply this to damp skin and massage it for just under a minute. It turns to a dull lather. Does a good job removing makeup and leaving skin squeaky clean without over drying. I've only used this in the evening since I don't cleanse in the morning—and it's perfect for that. It melts away makeup and doesn't leave any residue. The overall formula and function is great. I am not a fan of the scent. I prefer unscented products for my face, especially a cleanser that you're going to wash off anyways. Very unnecessary. Otherwise good!

avis.titre: You put it on damp skin, rub it in, and rinse it o
avis.texte: I received the Philosophy | Purity One-Step Meltaway Cleansing Balm free of charge in return for my honest and unbiased review. The cleansing balm is to be applied to a damp face and rubbed on your face to remove your makeup, then rinse it away. I picked up a small scoop of it on the end of my index finger to use and it was enough. I was able to clean the makeup off of my face and neck completely. It left my skin very clean, soft, and I had an even-feeling texture over all of my skin. The balm is thick, and does not run off of your hands before you're able to rub it in on your face. As an added bonus, it smells very nice. It comes in a small jar, but due to the small amount that you need, you should get a lot of uses out of it. I definitely recommend this to family, friends, and the public in general. Great product, Philosophy!

I really like this cleansing balm. I compared it with a balm I was using previously. This one is much more creamy and not oily. It does a good job of removing eye makeup quickly. It doesn't make my eyes feel gross after. A little goes a long way with this.
